question: What was India’s rank in terms of size of economy according to the GDP ranking of 2019 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5th.**__

__
 
• India ranked the world’s **5th largest economy**__ in terms of size according to the GDP ranking of 2019.
 
• The ranking was prepared by the IMF’s **October World Economic Outlook.**
 
• India had overtaken the UK in 2019 to become the fifth-largest economy in the world.
